description: Remove the background from a local image file or an image URL and save the result to disk. Returns the saved file path. Provide exactly one of input_path or image_url. When several objects or a person and a product appear together, the model may keep or drop some of them (for example a hand holding a product); use roi to restrict the subject area. Parts of a subject hidden behind something else cannot be recovered.

bg_color.description: Background colour such as ffffff or white. Omit for transparency.

clean_edges.description: Remove coloured fringes from the old background in hair, fur, and soft edges.

crop.description: Crop the output to the subject.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the source image.

input_path.description: Path to a local JPG, PNG or WebP image (max 12 MB).

output_path.description: Where to save the result. Defaults to '<input name>-no-bg.<ext>' next to the input, or the current directory for URLs.

overwrite.description: Replace output_path if it already exists.

roi.description: Region of interest as 'x1 y1 x2 y2' in px or %, e.g. '20% 10% 80% 95%'. Only the subject inside this box is kept.

size.description: preview ≈ 0.25 MP, medium 1.5 MP, hd 4 MP, full up to 25 MP.

name: remove_background
title: Remove image background
